name: EPIC 212026935

text.card: A red giant 1,894 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.04 solar masses and 8.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,660 K at its surface.
